Name: Pilot Penny (NPC Expansion)
Author: SiTheGreat1
Description:
[b]Description[/b]
Penny becomes a hot air balloon pilot! This character expansion mod adds 9 events along with letters, schedules, and two quests. This includes marriage schedules, but dating/marriage is [b]not required[/b] to enjoy this mod.

All of this mod's content begins after you reach 8 hearts with her and gift her a book. This mod can be added to preexisting saves, and the content will still work even if you're already married to her. This mod's events occur based on in-game time delays rather than heart levels, so whenever it's downloaded, you won't miss anything.

[b]Mod Compatibilities (so far)[/b]
[list]
[*][i][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3753]Stardew Valley Expanded[/url]﻿[/i]: compatible!
[*][i][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/6966]Community Center Reimagined[/url]﻿[/i]: compatible BUT CCR gives Penny a schedule every Thursday, while Pilot Penny gives her a schedule every other Thursday. If you're okay with her alternating weeks between the CC and her balloon then that works! If you'd rather she always go to the CC and never visit her balloon, then you can turn this mod's schedules off in the config.
[*][i][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9695]Little Red Schoolhouse[/url]﻿[/i]: compatible BUT if you turn 'Five Days' [b]on [/b]in the Schoolhouse mod's config, then you should turn 'PennyBalloonSched' [b]off [/b]in Pilot Penny's config.
[*][i][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/34252]Star Crossed[/url]﻿[/i]: compatible! If she marries Elliott, she'll visit the balloon/bookseller as usual and then return to their home.
[*][i][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/17775]Part of a Saloon Breakfast[/url]﻿[/i]: compatible! If you don't want Penny to visit the Saloon for breakfast before her balloon after finishing that mod's questline, there is an option in Pilot Penny's config to turn it off called 'PennySaloonBreakfastSched'.
[*][i]Event expansions[/i]: compatible with any event expansion (including [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/16279]Miihau's Penny Event Expansion[/url]﻿, [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/21095]Simple Penny Expanded[/url]﻿, and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/19505]Penny Expanded for 1.6[/url]﻿) that doesn't change her schedule. If you encounter a mod that does change her schedule, you can turn this mod's schedules off in the config (and let me know so I can try to add compat!).
[*][i]Dialogue expansions[/i]: compatible! This mod only adds conversation topic and location-based dialogue, so it will work with any mods that add or change dialogue.
[*][i]Sprite and portrait mods[/i]: compatible! This mod does not alter Penny's sprites or portraits, so it will work with any mods that do.
[/list][b]Events[/b][spoiler]
[list]
[*]After reaching 8 hearts with Penny, gift her any power book. She'll respond by asking where you got it from.
[*]Event 1: Town on a sunny day when the Bookseller present, between 9am and 5pm.
[*]Event 2: Town on a sunny day when the Bookseller present, between 9am and 5pm, at least 6 days after the last event.
[*]Event 3: Farm between 6am and 9am.
[*]Event 4: Saloon between 5pm and 10pm, at least 4 days after the last event.
[*]Event 5: Library between 10am and 2pm, at least 6 days after the last event.
[*]Event 6: Town on a sunny day when the Bookseller present, between 9am and 5pm.
[*]Event 7: Library between 8am and 12pm, at least 3 days after the last event. You'll get a letter with a quest the day after this event.
[*]Event 8: Farm at least 4 days after completing that quest. You'll receive a new quest.
[*]After completing that quest, you'll receive a letter about a week later, and then two more letters each spaced about a week apart.
[*]Event 9: Town on a sunny day between 6am and 4pm after receiving the last letter.
[/list][/spoiler]
[b]Dialogue[/b][spoiler]
Talk to Penny after each event! She has post-event dialogue for most of them. Pam and Emily also have dialogue following a few events.
Penny also has location dialogue specifically when she's visiting the Bookseller or her balloon.[/spoiler]
[b]Schedules[/b][spoiler]
[list]
[*]After Event 1, Penny will visit the Bookseller whenever he's in town on non-school days (school days are Tuesday, Wednesday, and Friday).
[*]After Event 9, Penny will check on her balloon near the Bookseller on the 11th and 25th (every other Thursday) of each month.[/spoiler]
[/list][b]Crossover Content[/b][spoiler]
[list]
[*][i][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/33203]Book Collecting[/url]﻿[/i]: When installed, this mod adds another 5 books for you to collect.[/spoiler]
[/list][b]Config[/b][spoiler]
[list]
[/list][list]
[*]PennyBalloonSched: Default enabled. When disabled, Penny will not stop by her balloon every other Thursday.
[*]PennyBooksellerSched: Default enabled. When disabled, Penny will not visit the Bookseller when he's in town on non-school days.
[*]CrossoverContent: Default enabled. When disabled, crossover content with other mods will not occur. See Crossover Content section above for more details.
[*]PennySaloonBreakfastSched: Default enabled. If [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/17775]Part of a Saloon Breakfast[/url]﻿ is installed and you've completed the questline, Penny automatically starts visiting for breakfast on Thursdays. If you've disabled that option for Penny in PoaSB's config, you'll need to disable it here as well or she'll still visit before going to her balloon/the bookseller on Thursdays.[/spoiler]
[/list]Check out my other NPC expansion mods!
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/18000]Adventurer Abigail[/url]
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/12667]Morris Redeemed[/url]﻿
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/27685]Sebastian's Frog Sanctuary
[/url]
[b]Translations[/b]
This mod is i18n-compatible! No AI translations please. Translators, you can either send me a translation file to be included in the main mod files, or maintain your own separate mod translation. If you choose to have your own separate translation mod, please ensure it requires my mod to be downloaded (either as a dependency or as a file replacer), and let me know once it's up. Thank you!

[b]Art Replacements[/b]
If you'd like to make and publish your own version of the art for Penny's balloon or the books, feel free! Just set my mod as a dependency and let me know once it's up. No AI art please. Thank you!

[b]Bug Reports
[/b]If you encounter any bugs or issues while playing, please post them in the Bugs tab [b]with a link to your SMAPI log[/b]. Include a SMAPI log [b]even if you don't see any errors[/b] in the SMAPI window. Instructions for generating a SMAPI log are here: [url=https://smapi.io/log]smapi.io/log[/url]
